title: [dualtor]: Tunnel packet handler leaks memory
author: theasianpianist

**Description**
The tunnel packet handler service running in the SWSS container was found to have a memory leak associated with receiving IPinIP packets from the standby ToR.

Since this service interacts with kernel netlink messages, a test is needed to cover possible memory leaks caused by future changes to kernel behavior/implementation.

<!--
Briefly describe the problem you are having in a few paragraphs.
-->

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
1. On a dual ToR testbed, confirm that the tunnel packet handler service is running in the SWSS container (`supervisorctl status tunnel_packet_handler`)
2. Send a continuous stream of IPinIP packets similar to those sent from the standby ToR to the active ToR
3. Check SWSS container memory consumption.

Summary:
Fixes #5018

The tunnel packet handler service running in the SWSS container was found to have a memory leak associated with receiving IPinIP packets from the standby ToR.

Add a new test script to check if there is memory leak for service tunnel_packet_handler.

### Type of change

<!--
- Fill x for your type of change.
- e.g.
- [x] Bug fix
-->

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Testbed and Framework(new/improvement)
- [x] Test case(new/improvement)


### Back port request
- [ ] 201911
- [ ] 202012

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?

#### How did you do it?
Test steps:
1. Send ip packets from standby TOR T1 to Server, standby TOR will forward the packets to active TOR with tunnel, active TOR will decapsulate the IPinIP packets, but there is no neighbor for destination as we remove neighbor before test, tunnel_packet_handler will be triggered and neighbor will be added. Then server will receive the packets. 
2. Check if memory usage percent is increased after tunnel_packet_handler's operation. Since tunnel_packet_handler is only triggered by the first packet, loop the process for all severs to trigger it as much as possible.
3. Also check if received packet number is more than 50%, otherwise test case will fail.

#### How did you verify/test it?
run test file tests/dualtor/test_tunnel_memory_leak.py

#### Any platform specific information?
DualTor
